title: Memorial Day Program and Lunch - Monday, 5/25/26 11AM - South Clubhouse
summary: Announcing our annual Palm Hill Memorial Day Program and Luncheon on Monday, May 25, 2026, to be held in the South Clubhouse main hall. Please join your fellow Palm Hillers in remembering our fallen brothers and sisters and to celebrate their memory by helping to carry on the values and principles that they so valiantly and bravely gave their lives.
